newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Trading at Karachi Stock Exchange to start late.
newsitem.headline: Trading at Karachi Stock Exchange to start late.

text.p: Trading at the Karachi Stock Exchange will start an hour later than usual on Monday because of a function to mark the Moslem feast of Eid al-Adha, an official at the exchange said.
Dealers said they expected share prices to be mixed in dull trade amid lack of investor interest when the market reopens after the four-day Eid al-Adha holiday.
On Wednesday, the 100-share index rose 3.02 points, or 0.20 percent, to end at 1,522.60. Losers led gainers 154 to 74 in a turnover of 45 million shares.
